# NVIDIA Video Codec API header

`nvEncodeAPI.h` is the unmodified MIT-licensed header from
[FFmpeg/nv-codec-headers n12.1.14.0](https://github.com/FFmpeg/nv-codec-headers/tree/n12.1.14.0/include/ffnvcodec).
The Windows exporter loads the system NVIDIA driver at runtime. The header
provides the ABI and is the only file vendored from that project.
